name: Shortest tube wavelength (Duane–Hunt)
meaning: Shortest X-ray wavelength (nm) from a tube at voltage V; eV is the electron kinetic energy in eV (numerically equal to V in volts).

name: Moseley's law (approximate)
meaning: Approximate Kα photon energy for an element of atomic number Z; about 8.0 keV for copper (Z = 29).

name: Bragg's law
meaning: Condition for constructive X-ray diffraction from planes spaced d (nm) apart; λ wavelength (nm), θ angle from the planes, n = 1, 2, 3, … the order. Diffractometers report 2θ.

name: Relativistic electron wavelength
meaning: de Broglie wavelength (m) of an electron accelerated through V volts; 0.0037 nm at 100 kV, 0.0025 nm at 200 kV.
